set_blocked_apps.name: Set blocked apps
set_blocked_apps.description: Set the blocked apps for a profile.

blocked_apps.name: Blocked apps
blocked_apps.description: (Required) List of apps to block. Passing an empty list will unblock all supported apps.

target_profile.name: Target profile(s)
target_profile.description: (Optional) Name(s) or ID(s) of profile(s) to set. Defaults to all profiles if not specified.

target_network.name: Target network(s)
target_network.description: (Optional) Name(s) or ID(s) of network(s) in which desired profile(s) are located. Defaults to all networks if not specified.

list_reservations.name: List DHCP reservations
list_reservations.description: Return the DHCP reservations on a network as a list of id, ip, mac, and description.

network.name: Network
network.description: Network id or name. Defaults to the entry's only network, or the first configured network.

create_reservation.name: Create DHCP reservation
create_reservation.description: Create one DHCP reservation. Refuses when the IP address or MAC address is already reserved. Set dry run to preview the change.

network.name: Network
network.description: Network id or name. Defaults to the entry's only network, or the first configured network.

dry_run.name: Dry run
dry_run.description: Return the planned change without creating the reservation.

update_reservation.name: Update DHCP reservation
update_reservation.description: Update the IP address or description of one reservation, found by reservation id or MAC address.

network.name: Network
network.description: Network id or name. Defaults to the entry's only network, or the first configured network.

reservation_id.name: Reservation id
reservation_id.description: Id of the reservation to update. Provide this or a MAC address.

mac.name: MAC address
mac.description: MAC address of the reservation to update. Provide this or a reservation id.

ip.name: IP address
ip.description: New IPv4 address. Omit to keep the current address.

description.name: Description
description.description: New label. Omit to keep the current label.

dry_run.name: Dry run
dry_run.description: Return the planned change without updating the reservation.

delete_reservation.name: Delete DHCP reservation
delete_reservation.description: Delete one DHCP reservation. Port forwards are kept (delete_forwards is always false).

network.name: Network
network.description: Network id or name. Defaults to the entry's only network, or the first configured network.

reservation_id.name: Reservation id
reservation_id.description: Id of the reservation to delete. Provide this or a MAC address.

mac.name: MAC address
mac.description: MAC address of the reservation to delete. Provide this or a reservation id.

dry_run.name: Dry run
dry_run.description: Return the planned change without deleting the reservation.

list_port_forwards.name: List port forwards
list_port_forwards.description: Return port forwards. Each rule includes id, ip, client_port, gateway_port, protocol, description, and enabled.

network.name: Network
network.description: Network id or name. Defaults to the entry's only network, or the first configured network.

create_port_forward.name: Create port forward
create_port_forward.description: Create one port forward. Refuses when the gateway port and protocol, or the IP, client port, and protocol, are already in use.

network.name: Network
network.description: Network id or name. Defaults to the entry's only network, or the first configured network.

ip.name: IP address
ip.description: Internal IPv4 address that receives the forwarded traffic.

description.name: Description
description.description: Label stored with the port forward.

enabled.name: Enabled
enabled.description: Whether the port forward is enabled. Defaults to on.

dry_run.name: Dry run
dry_run.description: Return the planned change without creating the port forward.

delete_port_forward.name: Delete port forward
delete_port_forward.description: Delete one port forward by id, or by IP address, gateway port, and protocol.

network.name: Network
network.description: Network id or name. Defaults to the entry's only network, or the first configured network.

forward_id.name: Port forward id
forward_id.description: Id of the port forward to delete.

ip.name: IP address
ip.description: Internal IPv4 address, used with gateway port and protocol when no id is given.

gateway_port.name: Gateway port
gateway_port.description: Gateway port, used with IP address and protocol when no id is given.

protocol.name: Protocol
protocol.description: tcp or udp, used with IP address and gateway port when no id is given.

dry_run.name: Dry run
dry_run.description: Return the planned change without deleting the port forward.

ip_table.name: IP table
ip_table.description: Return one row per device and per reservation that has no device, plus a summary.

config_entry_id.name: Config entry
config_entry_id.description: Eero account. Optional when only one entry is loaded.

network.name: Network
network.description: Network id or name. Defaults to the entry's only network, or the first configured network.

refresh.name: Refresh
refresh.description: Fetch devices and reservations now. Otherwise the last poll is returned.

reserve_ip.name: Reserve IP
reserve_ip.description: Create a DHCP reservation for a MAC. The IP defaults to the current address, or a free address when the device has none.

config_entry_id.name: Config entry
config_entry_id.description: Eero account. Optional when only one entry is loaded.

network.name: Network
network.description: Network id or name. Defaults to the entry's only network, or the first configured network.

ip.name: IP address
ip.description: Address to reserve. Defaults to the device's current address.

description.name: Description
description.description: Reservation label. Defaults to the Home Assistant device name, then the eero nickname, then the hostname.

suggest.name: Suggest a free address
suggest.description: Pick a free address instead of the current one.

force.name: Force
force.description: Reserve a private or randomized MAC address.

dry_run.name: Dry run
dry_run.description: Return the planned reservation without creating it.

release_ip.name: Release IP
release_ip.description: Delete the DHCP reservation for a MAC. Port forwards are kept.

config_entry_id.name: Config entry
config_entry_id.description: Eero account. Optional when only one entry is loaded.

network.name: Network
network.description: Network id or name. Defaults to the entry's only network, or the first configured network.

mac.name: MAC address
mac.description: MAC address whose reservation should be deleted.

dry_run.name: Dry run
dry_run.description: Return the planned deletion without deleting the reservation.

sync_names.name: Sync names
sync_names.description: Copy Home Assistant device names onto eero nicknames and reservation descriptions. Nothing is written back to Home Assistant. Dry run is the default.

network.name: Network
network.description: Network id or name. Defaults to the entry's only network, or the first configured network.

dry_run.name: Dry run
dry_run.description: Return the diff without writing. Defaults to true.

targets.name: Targets
targets.description: nickname, reservation, or both. Defaults to both.

prefix_area.name: Area prefix
prefix_area.description: when_missing prefixes the area when the Home Assistant name does not already contain it, and expands a name that is only the area with the model. never leaves the name as it is.

macs.name: MAC addresses
macs.description: Optional list of MACs to consider. Other devices are left out of the diff.

ip_in_use.message: IP address {ip} is already used by another reservation.

mac_in_use.message: MAC address {mac} is already used by another reservation.
